I told Pree in a thread on her question in #central-team that the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is **87 seats**.

On Oct 14 Hollis posted 268 in #central-team, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. Pree is a member of #central-team, so both of his messages are ones she can see herself. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it's fine to share with the Central team.
